title: Modal Hits $1B Run Rate and Raises $750M in Series D
summary:
The investment firm Accel spearheaded a fresh capital injection for Modal that brings the startup's total funding to $1.2B. This Series D round of $750M values the AI infrastructure provider at $15.75B post-money, and the company simultaneously announced it has crossed $1B in annualized run rate, indicating rapid revenue growth for its compute platform.

Modal has grown its scale more than 15x year-over-year, and usage of the platform has tripled since its previous Series C funding round. This expansion is driven by an increasing number of developers and enterprises using the startup's tools to build and deploy AI software.

We are deeply grateful to the developers and companies building on Modal. There's still so much more to build, and we can't think of a better time to be building software.
